title: Terrible experience
text:
Terrible experience. After 2 months it totally broke down, sounding like a jet plane screeching to a halt. Horrible tasting coffee as well, even with filters I bought and real kcups. Asked Amazon for a label to send it back even though 30 days were up. Paid almost $100 for it. No satisfaction from Amazon about it, in fact the rep lied to me, and assured me she would send a label and make it right. Never got it, and called back. They would not budge, and I was pretty upset. Never buy Mr. Coffee products...
I would definitely not recommend this.

description: Whether you prefer pods or drip, choose how you brew with the Mr. Coffee Pod + 10-Cup Space-Saving Combo Brewer. This programmable coffee maker lets you to brew a single cup using a pod or K-Cup*, or up to 10 cups of drip coffee into a carafe. The pod holder attachment makes this coffee maker more versatile: you can brew 2 ways, and save up to 50% more countertop space.** This coffee making machine is designed with a Strong Brew Selector, as well as an advanced water filtration system to help improve coffee flavor. This drip coffee maker also features a stainless steel thermal carafe that keeps coffee hot for hours. When brewing a carafe, if you need a cup before brewing is finished, use the Grab-a-Cup feature. Also includes removable reservoir, and a reusable single-serve filter. *K-Cup is a trademark of Keurig Green Mountain, Inc.
